notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey Jotunnslayers![/b][/p][p]We’re back with a quick [b]Hotfix[/b] to smooth out your experience. This update tackles some bugs and adds a few quality of life improvements based on your feedback. Thanks as always for slaying with us and letting us know how we can keep making the game better!
[/p][h3][b]Gameplay Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game could [b]freeze during objective selection in Endless Mode[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]elite chests stopped working after extended Endless runs[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed behavior when [b]no more skills were available on level up[/b] - players will now receive either Gold or a Heal instead, ensuring smoother progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]skill cards disappeared after using Seal[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Modifiers[/b] now display a progress bar for their unlock conditions, making it easier to track your goals.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Colorblindness settings[/b] have been refined for improved accessibility.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localized feedback forms[/b] added and updated for Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean players.[/p][/*][/list][p]
Keep the feedback and bug reports coming - we really appreciate it![/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Jotunnslayers! 

We’re excited to roll out [b]Patch 1.0.1[/b]! [/p][p]This patch focuses on [b]balance updates, bug fixes, and quality of life improvements[/b] inspired directly by your feedback. notes.title: Brutal roguelike Jotunnslayer reaches new levels of hellishness with 1.0 update
notes.notes:
Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel, which casts you as a vengeful, monster-slaying Viking, has slaughtered its way out of Steam Early Access. A Norse-themed mash-up of Diablo and Vampire Survivors, its co-developers have added a host of new content, hitting version 1.0. But, despite this grand achievement, they're not done yet. They've also outlined future plans for this frantic slay 'em up, so there's plenty more blood-spilling to look forward to.

notes.title: The Trials Are Over. The True Battle Begins: What the Playtests Will Change
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings, Jotunnslayers![/h3][p][/p][h3]First off, with the playtests now concluded, we owe you a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] for participating and sharing your thoughts on some of the key features that will shine in their full glory at the 1.0 release:[/h3][p][/p][olist][*][p]The full world of [b]Helheim[/b], with all that comes with it[/p][/*][*][p][b]Endless Mode[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/6f2386b18e76f2edae016c9d7275c29db2081ed2.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The number of players who joined both playtests exceeded our expectations, as did the [b]average playtime of 2 hours![/b][/p][p]After analyzing your in-game feedback and messages across channels, we found that the most appreciated feature was the [b]build variety and the freedom to experiment[/b]. On the other hand, the biggest frustration came from certain [b]overly punishing Omens and deaths that felt unfair[/b] due to balance issues.[/p][p][/p][p]If you thought the dev team was kicking back while you were testing, you’d be mistaken :D

On the contrary - we’ve been hard at work [b]balancing, optimizing, and bug fixing[/b] while you explored the new content.[/p][p]
[/p][h2]WHAT IMPROVEMENTS TO EXPECT IN 1.0 (AND ENDLESS MODE)?[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Omens rebalanced[/p][/*][*][p]Performance optimized[/p][/*][*][p]Objectives added[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy scaling adjusted[/p][/*][*][p]Leveling speed increased[/p][/*][*][p]Endless-incompatible skills handled[/p][/*][*][p]Item pools and interactable objects updated[/p][/*][*][p]Omen display improved in the HUD[/p][/*][*][p]Resource rewards in Endless clarified

[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/f1fb092c4801773307746bfa0d142c72397fcaa3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/b05cb51dd2410fc3f3131c8473466a050f6aac78.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/1fa7a48bf5b5944d08a6499a9c5b010a8549b6b9.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/819a7b5721fa200763249e51127fffa9e3ec47a7.png"][/img][/p][h2]
GENERAL FEEDBACK IMPLEMENTED[/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Skill/class balancing[/p][/*][*][p]Skill point cost reduction[/p][/*][*][p]UI animations enhanced[/p][/*][*][p]Encyclopedia added[/p][/*][*][p]Endless Mode playable on all maps[/p][/*][*][p]Statistics screen improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Extra cinematics added[/p][/*][*][p]Skill shop fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]If you forgot to share your thoughts - [b]it's not too late![/b][/p][p]Whenever you feel like it jump into [url="https://discord.com/channels/1224695009010516059/1390244354425360456" style="button"]#public-playtest-feedback on Discord[/url] to share your feedback freely.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re full speed ahead toward [b]1.0[/b]  -  mark the date:[/p][p]Jotunnslayer launches on PC and consoles [b]September 3.[/b][/p][p]

notes.title: 1.0 Release Date Revealed - Jotunnslayer Hits PC & Consoles Soon!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Jotunnslayers![/p][p][/p][h3]Big news has arrived [/h3][p][/p][h2][b]JOTUNNSLAYER: HORDES OF HEL - FULL RELEASE[/b] is launching on [b]SEPTEMBER 3[/b] for [b]PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S[/b]![/h2][p][/p][h3]As part of our publishing roadmap, you can expect the biggest update yet - featuring [b]HELHEIM[/b] and the long-awaited [b]ENDLESS MODE[/b].[/h3][h3]
[/h3][h3][b]WHAT TO EXPECT AT FULL LAUNCH:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]New Endless Mode[/b] - How long can you survive the Norse underworld?[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Class: Kinslayer[/b] - A fallen Valkyrie with a score to settle[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Deity: Nidhogg[/b] - From the depths below Yggdrasil[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Map: Helheim[/b] - A stunning, deadly new battlefield

[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Watch the full trailer and get a glimpse of what’s coming at 1.0:[/b] [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/vrVjDyc3N2k"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]PRICE ADJUSTMENT[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][b]By the end of this month[/b], [b]Jotunnslayer[/b] will see a price increase from [b]$9.99 to new price $14.99[/b], reflecting the expanded content, polish, and continued development.[/p][p]With the current price of [b]$9.99[/b], we wanted to [b]reward all players[/b] who stepped into the world of HEL early, giving them access to a game still in development. The fact that the vast majority of you found Early Access affordable made us confident we hit the right spot - and it helped welcome thousands of you -[b] true survivor fans[/b] into the Norse world of Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel.[/p][p][/p][p]If you haven’t grabbed your copy yet, [b]you can still get it at the current price of $9.99 until July 25[/b] - don’t miss out![/p][p][/p][p]—----------------[/p][p]This Early Access phase has been an incredible journey - and we’re grateful to the thousands of players who joined us early and believed in the project. [/p][p]More news coming soon![/p][p]This isn’t just a launch - it’s Ragnarök.[/p][p][/p][h2]Stay tuned. See you in HEL.[/h2][p]



[/p]

notes.title: SVARTALFHEIM DESCENT Has Arrived in Jotunnslayers: Hordes of Hel!
notes.notes:
[i]Hey Jotunnslayers![/i]


[h2]THE SVARTALFHEIM DESCENT 0.4 UPDATE[/h2]

has just crashed into the underworld - and it’s one of our biggest drops yet for Jotunnslayers: Hordes of Hel! Strap in, because this one’s packed.


[h1]NEW MAP - SVARTALFHEIM[/h1]
[i]Dark mines, unstable machinery, and forgotten madness.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/1cf77d4e8fbdb990c0b3affd0575eee49d479c25.png[/img]

Welcome to Svartalfheim, a sprawling, mine-themed battlefield crisscrossed with minecart railways, heavy steel gates, and ancient dwarven mechanisms. This once-glorious domain of the Svartalfar was home to master artisans who crafted artifacts for mortals and gods alike - until something broke them.

Now, the ruins whisper of:

[list]
[*] [b]New objectives[/b] tied to the sinister crystal that drove them mad
[*] Twisted map [b]modifiers[/b] that will shake even the hardiest of warriors
[*] A brutal [b]Construct Jötunn[/b] that guards the depths of the assembly line
[/list]


[h1]BOSS SPOTLIGHT: The Construct Jötunn[/h1]

An artificial colossus built by dwarves and powered by the same mysterious crystals mined throughout Svartalfheim.
Once a marvel of industrial might - equipped with saws, dredgers, and metallurgical tools - this Jötunn was upgraded for war when the descent into madness began. Now, it stands as the last line of defense… or perhaps the first line of vengeance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/85bdb5f5ed3ce8f91a574bb75820216d607d3835.jpg[/img]


[h1]NEW ENEMIES & MODIFIERS[/h1]

Flyers, spitters, troll riders, and goblin raiding parties now roam the mines

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/db6607422af75fe2c2f9584ce970de653bdfaf4a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/78549fb976b2239df832c2e5186e45f3ca721220.jpg[/img]

Prepare for blinding, mob density spikes, and brutal choice-based hindrances

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/3d0db065d47271805caa5e1ec766e85d7a44fe48.gif[/img]

Objectives like Crush & Carry add new tactical twists

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/244d74504726b44da59b0b543ebe82d98b218b24.png[/img]

[h1]NEW GOD DUO - BROKK & SINDRI[/h1]
[i]Forge masters. Rune whisperers. Unmatched artisans.[/i]

The legendary blacksmith brothers Brokk & Sindri join the Gods roster, though they’ve traded their anvil-forged weapons for the arcane art of Runecarving - because let’s face it, the Gods still have their weapons, but you don’t.
Their runes grant powerful passive stat bonuses to attacks, defense, and utility. Fully carving a rune unlocks peerless effects that can drastically enhance your build - for a price, of course. 
No dwarf works for free.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/062a115773cf87a43039314e22338d0cc66a6816.jpg[/img]


[h1]NEW CLASS/HERO - THE WARDEN[/h1]
[i]The last of his kind. A walking fortress. A dwarf with nothing left but honor and appetite.
[/i]
Introducing the [b]Warden[/b], a shield-bearing vanguard who once protected the noblest halls of Svartalfheim. Now? He drinks deep from his keg and swings harder than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/9a75a2d0eb65f24448a911dd24198816b76cbf8b.jpg[/img]

He’s a semi-ranged, hammer-and-board hero with:
[list]
[*] Heavy defense
[*] Crowd control
[*] A hunger for gold, food, and glory
[/list]

[b]Innate Traits[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]Ground Smash [/b]- Replaces dash with a knockback + AoE stomp 
[*] [b]Tower Shield[/b] - Passive chance to block and fully negate hits
[*] [b]Iron Within[/b] - Immune to slows, +200 bonus HP
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/734c0a47db67fb03c482b6b3a2d5ec1d753c57ea.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/01b0d51c4890501ae988799e1d09e70855652ece.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/ecc9fde529839a124ea77c5cb2694c2c5e3ec10a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/3793087ad6ba889d6846296609d610e045093702.gif[/img]


[b]
Subclasses[/b]
[list]
[*] Adventurer – Maximizes loot and XP gains
[*] Shieldbearer – Pure tank, pure pain
[*] Weapon Master – Turns your hammer into a god-tier weapon
[/list]


[h1]FIRST COMMUNITY EVENT - HOBGOBLINS EVERYWHERE![/h1]

Two-week event[b] starts today - May 13! [/b]
Introducing our first-ever limited-time event: [b]Hobgoblins Everywhere![/b]

A chaos-infused modifier spawns unique Hobgoblin enemies that:
[list]

notes.title: Hordes of Hel Just Got Balanced - A New Extraordinary God Joins the Fight!
notes.notes:
Hey Jotunnslayers!

As we’ve been reading and scanning your feedback and suggestions thoroughly, a lot of brainstorming has been done lately to find the best way to address your constant demand for making Jotunnslayer more distinctive and positioning it as an outstanding piece in the whole genre. We dare say the brainstorming session we had was so wild and fruitful that it hopefully  brought out something big enough and important for you all!

Coming as a surprise was a deliberate decision since our whole team believes this is the right twist we’ve been looking for from the beginning. But the decision wasn’t easy - honestly speaking, it took a lot of courage... but hey, when did boldness ever come easily?

We are introducing a new, utterly fresh figure to the world of Jotunnslayer. Even though he may not entirely fit the Norse aesthetic, we believe he adds to the striking uniqueness of the game...

meet

[h1]Karl the Accountant: The Balance Bringer[/h1]

[i]Lore [/i]

Born from the ashes of burnt receipts and the cries of overtaxed merchants, Karl the Accountant is a mysterious figure in the halls of Asgard. Legends say he can calculate compound interest faster than a Valkyrie can draw a blade and strike fear into the hearts of even the fiercest warriors with a stern glance over his half-moon spectacles. He exists to bring order - true balance - and painful audits to those who dare neglect their calculations and opt for mindless moves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/a26c59769d4e7c8191889886ba69e1d386f65620.png[/img]

[i]Karl’s Unique and Solid Abilities[/i]

[list]
[*] [b]Taxman’s Wrath (Ultimate Ability)[/b] It’s time to pay your dues! Karl slams down a giant ledger, causing a shockwave of flying receipts and paper cuts that deal true damage based on a percentage of the enemy's total HP. All nearby enemies are[b] "Audited"[/b] halving their damage output and [b]reducing movement speed for 5 seconds.[/b]

[*] [b]The Audit (Skill)[/b] Let’s take a closer look at those numbers! Karl marks an enemy for an Audit - scanning their weaknesses and revealing them to all allies. The target takes[b] 10% more damage[/b] from all sources and drops extra gold on death. If the target survives the Audit, Karl takes[b] interest damage.[/b]

[*] [b]Debt Collector (Skill)[/b] Pay what you owe! Karl throws a glowing contract that chains to [b]up to 3 enemies[/b]. Bound enemies are "In Debt" and take increased damage from all sources. If a target dies while In Debt, Karl gains a stack of [b]"Compound Interest" [/b]permanently increasing his damage [b]by 2% [/b](up to 10 stacks).

[*] [b]Asset Freeze (Skill)[/b] Your assets are frozen! Karl channels dark financial magic to [b]"Freeze"[/b] a target enemy, rooting them in place [b]for 3 seconds[/b]. While frozen, enemies take double damage from attacks, but Karl is unable to attack or move.

[*] [b]Revenue Stream (Skill) [/b] Steady returns! Karl summons a magical fountain of coins at a location, healing allies and damaging enemies [b]over 5 seconds[/b]. Allies in the area gain [b]10% increased movement speed[/b] while enemies suffer a Slow. At the end of the duration, the fountain bursts, scattering coins - [b]providing gold to nearby players.[/b]

[*] [b]Balance Sheet (Skill)[/b] Debits on the left, credits on the right! Karl conjures a magical balance sheet above an enemy, weighing their sins and debts. The enemy becomes "[b]Unbalanced[/b]" reducing their damage by 20% and increasing Karl’s damage against them by 30% for 6 seconds.
[/list]

-----------
We hope you find Karl brutal! Remember, even in Hel, the only things more certain than death are taxes!
Can’t wait to hear your thoughts! See you in Hel!
Cheers!

notes.title: DEV BLOG #13: Warm Up for the 0.2 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hey Jotunnslayers!

Welcome to [b]Dev Blog #13[/b] for Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel! The next update is bringing an entirely [b]new world - Jotunheim[/b] - along with the arrival of a powerful [b]new god, Skadi![/b]

In today’s blog, we’ll dive into the lore, game design, and visual aesthetics of Jotunheim’s harsh and unforgiving landscapes. We’ll also explore what Skadi brings to the battlefield and highlight additional improvements and fixes coming with this update.

Alright, let's go! 
—------------------

[b]HOW DOES THE JOTUNHEIM LOOK AND FEEL? [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/c19cc094678dd59229471a4c44c51536f8906d98.png[/img]

While trying to maintain familiarity with what the old Norse could have described as an alien giant-occupied landscape, we have imagined a cold, harsh, and barely hospitable tundra in the mountainous plateaus of Jotunheim. The realm's environment should be, after all, the reason for the Jotnar savagery and brutality.  

We have settled primarily around large basalt column structures, resembling a sort of purposeful giant-cut architecture. The uninviting, yet strangely cozy ambiance of stone-cold rock is underlined by volcanic sands, dry grass, and bone-to-leather props - all to create an eerily primal image.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/14fb0ec9551bc5670c18263a96c6db8fec6dbf25.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/8bd16fea1481f14eac6b7b4a641167cf873aa0e4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/ef152a5dda615fd2ebb46aab5e8d8f032057ca1e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/df1e92685e10e96cce7f961d9d874ae598a3fb6d.png[/img]


With the props being the main visual cues to reinforce the environment's theme, we have decided to amp up the ante of the map itself and introduce environmental hazards in the form of strong winds and magical basalt bridges that will connect individual plateaus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/8e7712174336f5ccea4eca631a0d4a029f5b11e2.gif[/img]

At the end of it all, Jotunheim should seem vivid and northerly exotic while feeling harsh and forbidding.

[b]NEW ENEMIES[/b]

Creatures and monsters you encounter in Jotunheim fit right into this fragmented yet primordial landscape. However, with a slight twist: in Jotunheim, everything might end up giant: giants among giants, staggering elementals, gargantuan insects - or the worst nightmare of all - enormous flying bugs!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/0c0dc457db0d965085c91dd1052d5eb8044a869a.gif[/img]

Yes, aside from the massive ancient civilization of shamans, throwers, and elemental hazards, Jotunheim has been invaded (or swarmed, rather) by relentless waves of insects. Unlike their colossal neighbors, these bugs can traverse the gorges without the need for magical footbridges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/29ff22208ede224b7a6abe6d479ac790a3e9a790.gif[/img]


[b]OBJECTIVES[/b]

Oppressive elements and invasive insects melt right down into the objectives awaiting you in Jotunheim as well. From venomous elementals, insect invasions, and newly tough, but not unfair Nithstangs.

notes.title: Dev Blog #12: Unleashing the Wolf Within - The Revenant Returns!
notes.notes:
Hi Jotunnslayers!

As we step into 2025 and[b] gear up for the Early Access launch[/b], it’s time to shine a spotlight on another class you’ll soon get to play.

For all the Revenant fans out there, welcome to Dev Blog #12 for Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel! This time, the focus is on the reworked and polished Revenant—a gem of a class that’s been upgraded thanks to your incredible feedback.

So, let’s dive in and see what the awakened and improved Revenant has to offer as we approach the Early Access launch!

[h1]REVENANT[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/d4c1f3f785f4316d8dd8763df2f203eec4a986b1.jpg[/img]

Once a feared marksman and a skilled hunter, the Revenant was tricked into being possessed by an ancient Wolf spirit. Now bound together for eternity, the two ravenously pursue vengeance against the one who deceived them.
The Revenant is a ranged class, using his archery skills and the Wolf's enhancements to dominate the battlefield. He controls enemies, outmaneuvers foes, and unleashes devastating arrows with precision.

[h1]WHAT IS THE REVENANT GOOD AT?[/h1]

While the Revenant debuted during Next Fest in a prototypical state, the version releasing now is fully refined and ready to show off its complete skillset. The Revenant is all about being the ultimate archer and hunter, with a kit designed to dominate from a distance.

[h1]What’s New?[/h1]

The most notable addition is [b]Heart Seeker[/b]—a skill that isn’t your average cupid’s arrow. The base version fires a single heart-piercing missile, while the evolved form unleashes a devastating volley of six arrows that tear through the battlefield.

WHAT’S NEW WITH SEERESS?[/b]

Hey Jotunnslayers!

Welcome to this[b] special Dev Blog, inspired by the fiery new world of Jotunnslayer—Muspelheim![/b] 

We’re excited to give you a sneak peek at what this scorching realm has in store.
Muspelheim is the realm of brimstone, molten lava, and unrelenting flames. It’s the primordial domain, the home of the Fire Giants, and their fearsome kin — elemental beasts and monstrous minions who will test your mettle at every turn.

Prepare for battle, because [b]Muspelheim is coming to Jotunnslayer in the Early Access version, launching January 21! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/8e16b24a88658b8d21dab91ea44034f174acdaac.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/2191341e59fdbf26d77715dde7e18b08fb7d0227.jpg[/img]


[h1][i]What’s awaiting you in Muspelheim?[/i][/h1]

[b]Welcome to Muspelheim, where THE OBJECTIVES have been reimagined to match the fiery intensity of this volatile world.[/b]

Lava Pools replace Graves, fiery Braziers illuminate the landscape, and dimensional Portals (they might offer a glimpse into the oblivion). But it’s not just about the visuals — these elements bring new mechanics with them. For example, the Curse of Winter has evolved into the Curse of Heat, challenging you with debilitating heat, or cataclysmic firestorms.

We’ve also added a new objective: [i]Runners[/i]. These elusive foes flee as you approach, leading you into the unknown — whether it’s an ambush by enemies or the hazards lurking in the shadows of brimstone.   

Lastly, in the realm of primordial flame you will face a number of positional puzzles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/7e7ff8d89dc444a7eb06c6c8b163f2d1462476ef.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/0ef84791204c2d57bfd643e6f540db6597139dff.gif[/img]



[b]Let’s talk HAZARDS - because in Muspelheim, danger takes on terrifying new forms.[/b]

Some hazards emerge as living nightmares, like the thorns. These spiked monstrosities spawn near you, impaling you and dealing damage on contact. Their unpredictable nature will keep you on the edge, and uncertain of every move.

Then, there are the Mortars — a more tactical threat. These fiery artillery units spawn at a distance, raining down a relentless barrage on your position. Their ammunition is infinite, they fire without mercy, and most importantly increase in number with passing time. But like any stationary weapon, they have a weakness: track them using your minimap, close the distance, and eliminate them before they reduce you to smoldering ashes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/78f7e5cff230dd760b47f106ce4fcb24eec8d784.gif[/img]

While many retain the behaviors of their Niflheim counterparts, the enemies in Muspelheim sport their own molten look that reflects the heat and chaos of the Muspel. Some have even received enhanced visual effects - you can be sure that under all that craggy exterior, there is a warm hearth.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/43ce66be39c5eb2d92a662018074ec034877c5b6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/45889b38f7ef13a96c801a2bc98c4c96265030aa.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/7a00c69c394fafefcd32dbe4f54741d5b8a41a8a.gif[/img]

But as you successfully complete the challenges of the fiery realm, you quickly realize that it will be YOU who will be summoned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/f900b42f00f043e638ebffc29f18c6985e322a7c.png[/img]


That’s a wrap for this dev blog on freshly introduced world Muspelheim, Jotunnslayers! 
[b]A huge shoutout to everyone of you - your feedback has been nothing short of legendary. [/b]
You’ve helped shape the world of Jotunnslayer, and we can’t wait to show you what’s next.

Thank you so much for participating in the Jotunnslayer playtest and for the incredible feedback you've shared so far. Like we already mentioned multiple times, [b]your input is invaluable at this stage of development.[/b] Remember, our next milestone is a polished and fine-tuned public demo, so your help during this playtest phase is crucial!

[b]WE HEAR YOU![/b]

While we've received plenty of praise for the overall experience in Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel, we want to share our future development direction, focusing on common feedback themes that we aim to improve.

[i]Content Variety[/i]

[b]We want more variety, too!  [/b]

Have in mind that the playtest offered just a small glimpse of what's to come - one character and a single level. On the other hand, the [b]Early Access release will feature a much larger pool of content[/b], including more characters, weapons, gods, map and modifiers. We’ll also continue adding even more content periodically after the EA release.

[i]Character Building[/i]

We're constantly improving character builds, but despite our efforts to ensure multiple viable options for each class, some ideas may not have hit the mark. In that sense, our next step is to analyze which builds are most popular, which skills are underused, and how we can enhance variety.

[i]Impact of Skill Choices[/i]

We’re introducing evolved versions of each skill at level 4 to provide exciting goals and reward players for specializing their builds.

[i]Challenge and Difficulty[/i]

Using analytics, we'll identify difficulty spikes and uneventful moments in players' runs to ensure a smoother and more engaging experience.


[b]ANYTHING IMPROVED IN THE MEANTIME?[/b]

Absolutely! While focusing on new content and fine-tuning gameplay mechanics, we are making several technical improvements:

New Video and Controls Settings:

- Framerate cap
- Screen shake intensity
- Controller vibration intensity
- Key bindings


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/35fd8c4db20c29a3997ed9f5f60ee53503d8654a.png[/img]


Better PS4 controller support
Enhanced support for ultra-wide screen resolutions

Performance optimizations:
- Ice shader optimization
- VFX pooling and culling improvements
- Decal renderer optimization
- Multiple bug fixes


[b]THE ULTIMATE GOAL[/b]

Our core vision with Jotunnslayer focuses on a strong, polished game experience built around action roguelike and survivor genre pillars. But no worries, we also see vast opportunities for improvement and exploration. With our current ritual/event system, there's ample space to develop unique map mechanics, rituals, and bosses, making Jotunnslayer truly stand out is what we all strive for. 


[b]REQUEST YOUR SPOT IN THE PLAYTEST[/b]

[b]The playtest period has been extended until further notice. [/b]

[b]Sign up now to secure your spot! [/b]

Help us shape the future of Jotunnslayer. The feedback form is at the end of the playtest—[b]please don't skip it![/b]


If you haven’t already, join our awesome community of Survivors on [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/Zst6agwu8v]Discord.[/url][/b] 

Thanks for helping us out! 
Until the upcoming improvements, keep on slaying!
Cheers!

notes.title: Jotunnslayer Dev Blog #4 - Playtest Expansion and Quest System Feedback
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

We're happy to share that the [b]number of sign-ups[/b] for our playtest has[b] exceeded our expectations[/b]. Your constructive feedback is incredibly valuable as we develop Jotunnslayer together, and we’re thrilled with the response rate so far.

To show our appreciation, we’ve decided [b]to extend the playtest and grant more of you access to this closed beta [/b] before we release the public demo. We'll be granting[b] 200 access slots per day[/b] to ensure that everyone interested gets a chance to play. Access will be given in waves to manage the feedback analysis workload effectively.

While we refine the game experience based on your feedback, we're working hard to deliver a public demo in the upcoming weeks that you’re going to love!

[b]WHAT'S NEW IN THE PLAYTEST BUILD? [/b]

And since the team has already started fine-tuning and implementing your feedback at full steam, a new build is now available for playtesting with the following fixes:
[b]
Gameplay[/b]

- Lowered the amount of XP needed for level-up (Max Level changed from 20 to 25)
- Reduced damage from Skeleton arrows and Suiciders
- Increased explosion delay for Suiciders
- Decreased Bone Jotunn contact damage
- Decreased movement speed of Loot Bat
- Removed collision on treasure chests
- Added XP drops from Objectives
- Reworked XP rewards from Objectives & Items, which now increase with hero progress
- New skill for later versions of Skeleton Spellcaster
- Removed Trinkets from chest rewards
- Reduced prices of Temple Passives

[b]UI[/b]

- Added missing icons for Skills and Difficulties
- Reworked Character Statistics on the Pause Screen
- Simplified HUD
- Tweaked Minimap zoom

[b]Technical[/b]

- Added optional data collection for gameplay improvement purposes
- Minor performance optimizations

[b]SFX[/b]

- Added Objective Completed and New Objective sounds
- Added new Bone Jotunn ability sounds
- Added Brazier sounds
- Added Suicider spawn, death, and explosion sounds
- Added Loot Goblin hit and death sounds
- Added Freya and Thor passives trigger sounds

[b]Bugs Fixed[/b]

- Enemies spawning outside of the map
- Mouse cursor disappearing when switching to gamepad
- Circular spawn waves not working correctly

—----

Finally, let's wrap up today’s Dev Blog with some words from our Lead Game Designer, Marek Hlavaty:

[i]Recently, we conducted a closed test to see if our game is ready for a public demo. After addressing major issues found in our internal test last month, feedback indicates the game is fun to play. Based on this feedback we continue to improve the experience, and we are on track to deliver a public demo we know you will enjoy. Thanks to everyone who provided feedback—it was truly invaluable!

I’d like to add that we’re particularly curious about our quest system. Currently, each run has fixed quests, allowing players to prepare but making the gameplay somewhat repetitive. To mix things up, we’re considering randomizing quests based on your suggestions.

Random quests might be unbalanced—some runs could be very tough, others too easy. But we're willing to give it a try. For this, we need a diverse pool of quests. We have some ideas, but we want to hear yours too!

[b][url=https://discord.com/invite/Zst6agwu8v]Share your quest ideas on our Discord.[/url][/b] Your suggestion might just make it into the game! We look forward to your contributions as always! 

Keep up the amazing job![/i]

—------

Thanks for being here and helping us shape Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel into a hell of an adventure!

Stay tuned for more updates, and keep slaying!

Cheers,
The Jotunnslayer Team

In Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel, Thor is the mighty God of Thunder wielding his legendary hammer, Mjölnir. He is one of the gods who aids the player by lending them [b]his powers through various passive and active abilities.
[/b]
Thor commands storms and lightning to vanquish his enemies and inspire his allies. As Odin's son and protector of humanity, Thor's valor and strength are unmatched. Thor will offer his powers to assist you in epic battles and heroic hunts against his eternal enemy - the Jotunn and their perilous hordes.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/a1d70b83c8f17919d5ca35cf894700da25363dbc.png[/img]


[b]Thor's Passive Skills[/b]

Thor's passive boons revolve around his command of thunder and lightning, such as the chance to sprout chain lightning that jumps from enemy to enemy. His unparalleled might can increase your health, chances to stun enemies, or generally improve your power and prowess with enhanced skill damage and critical chances.

[b]Thor's Active Skills[/b]

[b]Lightning Strike[/b]

Thor summons the fury of the heavens, bursting lightning bolts in a crisscross pattern. Each strike delivers a powerful blast of electrical energy that damages foes in its path. At higher levels, the Lightning Strikes may become more frequent and increasingly devastating.

[b]Thunderstorm[/b]

Thor calls down a barrage of lightning strikes, each one impacting a small area and wreaking havoc on those caught within. The storm grows more ferocious with each use, striking more frequently and covering a wider area, leaving no place safe for his enemies.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/d0ab7e9e62f16bf7fcc31152a19aec1aa12f01c0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/dc1e52c8616b4421943dea430bf186e1d4d14b37.gif[/img]

notes.title: Jotunnslayer Dev Blog #2: Unveiling Class Concepts and Backstories
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

In today’s [b]DevBlog Episode #2[/b], we're diving into the remaining classes that will join you in the grim Norse universe of Jotunnslayer. Alongside the [b]Berserker[/b], who we showcased in the previous episode, you'll have the chance to play, later on in the Early Access, as: [b]the Revenant[/b], a possessed hunter, [b]the Scoundrel[/b], an assassin of the Flame, and [b]the Seeress[/b], a dark witch. Let’s take a closer look at what makes them so formidable.

[h2][b]Class: Revenant[/b][/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/f21c003674c1fbd285da2a368c611ddd7bb21609.png[/img]


Weapon: Bow

Once a feared marksman and a skillful hunter, the Revenant has been tricked by once betrayed and long disgraced ancient Wight. The Wight once controlled a heroic warrior, to whose restless corpse the Wight tricked the smug hunter. When the query was slain, the spirit possessed the hunter, making him a formidable vessel of both his powers, and the quest for vengeance.

The Revenant is a ranged class utilizing his prowess and Wight’s powers, enhancing his archery skills and hunting abilities to help him keep control over his enemies, and allow for better positioning to best utilize the effects of his arrows.
[b]
Revenant`s abilities:[/b]

[b]Ethereal Arrows[/b]
Revenant’s arrows have a chance to turn ethereal and pass through enemies, allowing the arrows to hit multiple targets in a single shot.

[b]Undying[/b]
The Revenant has a chance to heal a portion of their health with a well-placed killing blow, enhancing their survivability during battles.

[b]Ghost walk[/b]
During a dash, the Revenant becomes immune to damage and has a chance to enter a Ghostwalk state, which boosts their offensive capabilities for a short time.

[b]Basic Attack:[/b]
The Revenant fires a cone of three arrows with each attack. This attack pattern covers a wider area, making it effective against groups of enemies.




[h2][b]Class: Scoundrel[/b][/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/11aee8b351df3b80f9192b360525fa3eb55e3ef4.png[/img]


Weapons: Daggers

Although empowered by fiery spirits and fanatical in their devotion to Loki’s trickery and ingenuity,  the Followers of the Flame have been shunned as outcasts and blasphemers for ages. In the true honor of her ever-defiant patron and empowered by the diligent training of the sisterhood, the Scoundrel seeks redemption for her deeds and vows to be unshackled from the bounds of fate and superstition.  

Scoundrel is a highly mobile melee class specializing in swift, lethal strikes and fiery chaos. With a deadly combination of daggers and fire, she excels in offense but lacks defensive capabilities making her a high-risk high-reward class choice.

[b]Scoundrel abilities: [/b]

[b]Lethal Strike[/b]
When the Scoundrel lands a critical hit, the damage is amplified by fiery enhancements, causing devastating burns to enemies, and has increased chances to immediately dispatch her foes.

[b]Dasher[/b]
This ability grants the Scoundrel an additional dash, allowing for quick repositioning in battle. This extra mobility is crucial for evading attacks and closing gaps to strike enemies.

[b]Blazing Soul[/b]
The Scoundrel’s soul is a volatile source of Loki’s finicky fiery power. Unpredictably, it might erupt into a ring of flames, damaging and burning all enemies nearby. This spontaneous combustion adds an element of unpredictability and continuous damage to the Scoundrel's arsenal.

[b]Basic Attack:[/b]
The Scoundrel's basic attack may alternate between a flurry of swift dagger strikes, or a fiery blast. This combination keeps opponents guessing and diversifies the damage output. The dagger strikes are quick and precise, while the flame attack delivers a powerful burst of fire.



[h2][b]Class: Seeress[/b][/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/1b045c60e1289e9b7d182d0e67fcbe312c7989fc.png[/img]


Weapon: Staff

Ever reclusive and mysteriously powerful, the Seeress has long been the target of both the desperate, looking for their forlorn hope; and the contemptuous, seeking the end of her sinister and eldritch ways. A shadowy and clairvoyant opportunist, able to invoke contempt in the desperate, and desperation for contempt, she seeks to once outsmart the very ancients with her mastery of dark ancient arts.

The Dark Seeress is a dark, staff-wielding witch, perfect for players seeking an eldritch spell caster. She uses her mystical foresight and dark magic to protect herself and deal damage to her enemies.

[b]Seerees abilities:[/b]

[b]Malicious Wisdom[/b] As the Seeress collects experience crystals, these can sometimes inflict dark damage on enemies they pass through, turning her growth into a weapon against her foes.

[b]Augur[/b]
With her ability to foresee the future, the Seeress enjoys increased luck, providing her with additional options for skills and trinkets, enhancing her versatility and power.

[b]Eldritch Wards[/b]
Over time, the Seeress is surrounded by protective energy shields that grant her brief periods of invulnerability when struck, allowing her to withstand enemy attacks effortlessly.

[b]Basic Attack:[/b]
She releases an eldritch raven from her staff, which explodes on impact, damaging all enemies within its blast radius. This attack is effective in dealing with groups of enemies and maintaining control over the battlefield.


That's it for today!

Just a reminder, these classes are still a work in progress, and to remember that your feedback will shape them into the champions you need in the battles ahead. Next time, [b]we'll dive into the Norse Gods [/b]who may lend you their hand (or maybe throw a challenge) in the realms of Jotunnslayer. 

Cheers Survivors and keep your eyes peeled for more updates!

notes.title: Jotunnslayer Devblog #1 - Exploring World and Introducing the Berserker Class
notes.notes:
Hey there, fellow Survivors!

We're beyond excited to kick off the very first episode of our Jotunnslayer Devblog series! 

We can't wait to take you on a wild journey through the dark and thrilling realms of Norse mythology. 

First…

[h2][b]Welcome to the bleak and hostile world of Jotunnslayer[/b][/h2]

[b]Setting[/b]

In Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel, you’ll find yourself on Helveg – on a long, long path to Helheim. It’s a desolate place in a cold and dark wasteland where you are attested with numerous Trials to be completed to moving on. And your first trial will be a journey to Niflheim - a harsh and treacherous homeland of primordial cold, mist, and ice. Here you will have to prove yourself worthy to advance and face the dreaded hordes of Hel!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/066e1082186cf1381ea3b789818209507fef0323.jpg[/img]


[b]Lore and Mythology[/b]

Norse Gods: Along your journey, you'll come across divine beings from Norse mythology. These gods will bestow blessings upon you, boosting your abilities and giving you that edge you need to survive. We`ll put a spotlight on them in one of the upcoming devblogs for sure. 

Epic Battles: Get ready for some epic showdowns! You'll face waves of relentless enemies and mighty bosses. Each battle is a test of your skills, strategy, and endurance. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/2a02d1cdca608d86b312994c5b47021d40139cbb.png[/img]


[b]
Atmosphere[/b]

Bleak and Foreboding: The vibe here is consistently dark and tense, perfectly capturing the perilous nature of the Norse Nine Worlds.

Immersive Soundscape: With haunting music and eerie sound effects, you'll feel like you're truly in this grim, otherworldly realm.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/b253d5d9bbf29f005dd25808e2799055dc2d5a64.jpg[/img]


Let's now move to the

[h2][b]Introducing Classes[/b][/h2]

Today, we're introducing our first badass hero—[b]the Berserker![/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/a5a438ce8c1c5c6b35cfb0f99171e5ee698bf3c3.jpg[/img]


[b]Berserker: Raging Warrior[/b]

The Berserker class is tailored to a moderate level of difficulty, designed to thrive in the thick of battle through its two core mechanics: Hot Blood and Rage. These mechanics, detailed below, complement each other to enhance the Berserker's combat effectiveness. Additionally, the class's passive abilities, as demonstrated in previous demos, further bolster its playstyle centered around these innate strengths.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/7f6fba69b881d2d33e4e0d72dbc803a8ba54c2a1.jpg[/img]

[b]Attack[/b]

The Berserker's primary attack, Double Swing, unleashes swift, wide arcs in front of them. This aggressive melee technique allows the Berserker to swiftly engage enemies within reach, making them formidable in close combat situations.

[b]Hot Blood & Survivor[/b]

Unleashing fury :). The Berserker's [b]Hot Blood[/b] mechanic intensifies their combat prowess as their health diminishes. For every health lost, their attack speed surges. This effect is further enhanced by the passive skill, Boiling Blood, which can be upgraded to augment this innate ability.

[b]Survivor[/b] mechanics gives to the Berserker more starting HP than other classes and also a small portion of natural regeneration, because Berserker thrive in battles and is able to 
windstad longer as others.

[b]Rage[/b]

During moments of heightened intensity, Berserker can enter a special state known as Rage, activated randomly with a chance upon attacking. In this state, they experience a significant surge in capabilities: movement speed increases, damage output amplifies, and health regenerates at an accelerated rate. This heightened state lasts for a basic duration of few seconds, empowering them to swiftly maneuver through challenges and deal devastating blows to adversaries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44902475/9e817cc8e1e02a1ff8949ff257d49e96081eb3b0.jpg[/img]

---

Next time comes more! You’ll get a sneak peek into the [b]class concept design[/b]! We’re super excited to hear what you think so far.

Stay tuned for more updates in our next Devblog episode!

Cheers, Survivors!

Feel free to drop your comments and feedback on Steam or Discord. We’re all ears and eager to hear how we can make this journey even more epic for you.

See you in Nine Worlds (very soon)!
